description:
POST one sample payload to the configured URL right now and report what came back. This is how to check a webhook works BEFORE enabling it: it deliberately ignores the enabled flag and the event subscription. It reaches a real third-party endpoint but spends no credit. The payload is obviously fake sample data.

Requires scope `webhooks:write`.

event.description: An event id. These are camelCase because they are the literal `event` field of the JSON we POST, not API fields.

name: test_webhook
title: Send a test webhook event
